ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. The published V2 client and documentation currently use an unencrypted HTTP API, while the linked HTTPS V2 host and client repository are unavailable. CTAS therefore withholds automatic ingestion until ASAS-SN publishes a current secure, bounded machine-access contract. This is an interface-integrity boundary, not a claim that the public light-curve data are proprietary.
